evidence.decision: Defines system/live appearance switching, qualified permanent-dark exceptions, base/elevated hierarchy and conditional asset reuse/variants.
evidence.artifact: Delivers corrected appearance tokens/assets or a review naming exact failing pairs and active-state transitions.
evidence.transformation: Notes editor replaces mechanical inversion/fixed gray/white diagram with semantic surfaces/text, distinct elevated panels and a readable diagram treatment.
evidence.verification: Tests contrast/transparency settings separately and together; fails residual light-only elements, merged elevation and worsened readability.
evidence.applicability: Explicitly scopes supported platforms, excludes visionOS/Watch Dark Mode and preserves Mac neutral-tint versus colored-state constraints.
evidence.handoffs: Uses Color for semantic assignment and Images only for asset-production faults.
evidence.distinctiveness: Appearance transitions and elevated hierarchy are tested as stateful behavior rather than a dark palette summary.
